author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at some of the puzzles and more in this trailer for Escape the Baby Alarm, an upcoming short, relaxing puzzle game built around escape-room-inspired challenges. It’s an honest and cozy take on the chaos and love of early parenthood, reshaping the noise, mess, and constant mental juggling of the first year into something calm and playable. Escape the Baby Alarm will be available on PC and mobile. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Escape the Baby Alarm - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Journey to the center of the planet in Piroot, an open-world Metroidvania adventure game! Explore and survive as a shipwreck's lonely survivor. What secrets lie at the planet's core, and can you trust the voice leading you there? Piroot will be available in Early Access on PC.
title: Piroot - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a horror/puzzle adventure for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. Reactivate power, lights and complex machinery. Learn about long-gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone. Get a look at gameplay from Confined: Leaving OKB-134 in the latest trailer. The full releaes of Confined: Leaving OKB-134 will be available on PC via Steam and Steam VR in 2026. A demo update is coming soon.
title: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 - Official Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Season 2 Trailer for Splitgate: Arena Reloaded, the hit first-person arena shooter developed by 1047 Games. Players can gain access to a suite of new content from a new battle pass to progress through, a new Power Weapon, Duo queue in Arena Royale, and more. Fight across new maps, both brand-new and returning, in Season 2 of Splitgate: Arena Reloaded, launching on March 27 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#SplitgateArenaReloaded #Gaming #IGN
title: Splitgate: Arena Reloaded - Official Season 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: System Overload is a hand-drawn acrobatic shooter about parrying enemy bullets and turning them into your own. Destroy an evil robot megacorp by vandalizing the streets with their blood, performing stylish parkour, and dancing through a bullet ballet - all fueled by your hatred for the system. Check out the System Overload trailer to see gameplay and more. System Overload will be available on PC, and you can join the playtest on Steam if you're interested.
title: System Overload - Official Alpha Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Raw Components Racing, a sci-fi racing game developed by the RCR Team. Players will enter a new world where the space race is taken literally, as pilots merge their minds into advanced Racing Vessels with interchangeable components to race across the cosmos at ultra-fast speeds. Become one with the vehicle in Raw Components Racing, coming soon.

#RawComponentsRacing #Gaming #IGN
title: Raw Components Racing - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Inn Over Your Head announcement trailer for this upcoming incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Inn Over Your Head will be available on PC in 2026. A demo is out now on itch.io.
title: Inn Over Your Head - Official Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at gameplay and more in the Squingle Arcade trailer for the upcoming VR and Mixed Reality game. Squingle Arcade will be available on Meta Quest, Steam VR, Apple Vision Pro, and Pico.
title: Squingle Arcade - Official Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Isle of Food is a VR cooking simulator and island adventure where every dish begins with open-world exploration. You own a seaside restaurant on a tropical island and welcome new guests every day. To cook meals, ingredients must be found across the island by hunting, fishing, gathering plants, and growing crops. Cooking and serving dishes earns money and experience, allowing you to upgrade the restaurant, unlock new recipes, skills, and inventory items. Isle of Food will be available on Steam VR, PlayStation VR, Meta Quest, Pico, and Epic Games Store in 2026.
title: Isle of Food - Official Gameplay Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: VR Steam Train _ Zombie Action. Zombies infest Necropolis island and Queen Victoria is not best pleased. Grab your shotgun, ride the rune train and slay the undead. It's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction! Full Steam Undead will be available on Meta Quest and SteamVR.
title: Full Steam Undead - Official Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Build your hero, adventure your way, and forge your legend! Check out the EverQuest Legends announcement trailer for this upcoming game from Daybreak Games and independent development studio Game Jawn. EverQuest Legends is a fan-driven collaboration designed to give players a new way to experience classic EverQuest. EverQuest Legends takes players back to the early days of the trailblazing MMORPG with restored sound and visuals and all-new quality-of-life enhancements designed to make it more approachable for new and returning adventurers.

A closed beta for EverQuest Legends will be available in April ahead of its planned July 2026 launch.
title: EverQuest Legends - Official Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Prepare for the most authentic hunting simulator in virtual reality. Virtual Hunter offers a large open wilderness where you can track and hunt animals like the majestic red deer and wild boar, all with unique, realistic behaviors. Customize your hunt with a variety of weapons and gear, and rely on the accurate weapon stabilization system for clean shots. Celebrate your best achievements by placing taxidermied trophies around your lodge with the unique trophy mount system, or experience the thrill of the hunt together with up to 6 players. Virtual Hunter will be avaialble on PS VR2 and Meta on May 27, 2026.
title: Virtual Hunter - Official Release Date Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: A Long Survive is a cooperative survival shooter focused on resource management and battling the largest waves of enemies ever seen in VR. You'll need to devise real-time strategies and efficiently build defenses to fortify the area if you want to survive. Choose from four unique heroes, each with their own special abilities, and unlock powerful skills, weapons, and structures through a dynamic progression system. A Long Survive is available on Meta Quest, and it is coming to SteamVR & PSVR2 on April 30, 2026.
title: A Long Survive - Official Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Peak Rhythm is a VR rhythm-climbing game where music drives momentum. Every grab and twist powers your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city. Peak Rhythm is available now in Early Access on Meta Quest, and the Multiplayer update is out now.
title: Peak Rhythm - Official Multiplayer Update Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Shop & Stuff, the quirky VR supermarket simulator where chaos is just part of the fun! Pile up goodies, charm wild customers, chase off shoplifters, and deal with messy spills. Start small in this roadside mini-market and hustle your way through each day by keeping shoppers happy. Bring in the bucks to expand your store and purchase new equipment to streamline operations. Can you turn your little shop into a thriving business? Welcome to Shop & Stuff! Shop & Stuff is available now on Meta Quest, and coming to PSVR 2 on March 27, 2026.
title: Shop & Stuff - Official Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: How to God is an immersive VR god simulation game allowing you to step into the divine sandals of a beginner god. Build up your villages, raise a unique creature, battle rival deities and command the elements to unlock new powers. Watch the latest How to God trailer to see what to expect with the new Good or Evil update, which adds in new and impactful alignment choices as well as visual upgrades for your creature - all based on your choices! How to God is available now on Meta Quest and it is coming to Steam VR. The latest How to God content update is coming soon.
title: How to God - Official Update Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Bloxer is available now on Meta Quest. Watch the Bloxer launch trailer for this game that combines physical movements with real-time strategic thinking in a vibrant pixel environment. Punch your robot ‘’friend’’ to align correct blocks together in rows or columns and chain those to get extra combo points. Compete in a lobby of up to 9 players online and train not only your muscles, but also your brain! Knockdown the other contenders and climb the leaderboards to become the best Bloxer on this planet… and other planets too.
title: Bloxer - Official Launch Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Automate hell and construct a sin-punishment empire in Sintopia. Watch the latest Sintopia trailer for this mix of builder and God game, with an asymmetrical loop and you are the freshly promoted middle manager of Hell Incorporated. As hell’s administrator, it’s your job to re-educate sinners and resurrect the worthy. Build sin-punishment facilities, manage ‘imployees’ and exert your influence on the surface in a thriving Overworld. Sintopia will be available on PC via Steam on April 16, 2026.
title: Sintopia - Official New Release Date Trailer

description:
Watch the latest Rainbow Six Siege trailer to see what you can expect with the Tubarão Elite bundle, available now. ubarão holds the line for his squad in the face of despair—like a carnation holding onto hope in the cold.

#RainbowSixSiege #Gaming #IGN
title: Rainbow Six Siege - Official Tubarão Elite Trailer

description:
Watch the latest RoadCraft trailer to see what you can expect with the Reclaim Expansion, which brings two new maps and seven vehicles, as well as brand-new demolition and salvage gameplay to the physics sandbox sim game. RoadCraft's Reclaim Expansion is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S.

#RoadCraft #Gaming #IGN
title: RoadCraft - Official Reclaim Expansion Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Season 3 Story Cinematic Trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest addition to the hit first-person shooter franchise developed by Treyarch. Players can take a look at the latest cinematic that introduces Season 3 with a bang as JSOC and The Guild continue their feud. Season 3 for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is launching on April 2 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Official Season 3 Story Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Teamwork and betrayal in space! In this PC & VR party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original Among Us, but now in all three dimensions. Among Us 3D: Definitive Edition will be available on Steam, Steam VR, Meta Horizon Store, PS VR2, and PICO in April 2026.

#AmongUs3D #Gaming #IGN
title: Among Us 3D: Definitive Edition - Official Release Window Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Blood Moon Event 2026 Trailer for Dead by Daylight, the asymmetrical action multiplayer horror game developed by Behaviour Interactive. Players will be able to access new content from the upcoming event, including unlockable rewards, Blood Generators, and community challenges to complete as a player base. Turn to the crimson moon during the Blood Moon Event for Dead by Daylight, running from March 26 through April 16.
title: Dead by Daylight - Official Blood Moon Event 2026 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out over 3 minutes of gameplay from The Boys: Trigger Warning in this latest video for the upcoming first-person VR action game. Developed with the creators and featuring cast from the hit series, “The Boys: Trigger Warning” plunges you into the gloriously twisted world of The Boys. This time, you’re not watching the chaos—you’re in it: close-up, personal, and dangerously real.

Lucas Costa’s life detonates when the Armstrongs—a washed-up but still lethal family of Vought Superheroes—turn a family outing into carnage. The Boys drag Lucas back from the brink, juice him with powers, and throw him headfirst into their filthy underground war against Vought and its Supes. With Butcher and Mother’s Milk guiding from the shadows, Lucas sets off on a no-mercy hunt to put the Armstrongs in the ground.

The Boys: Trigger Warning will b available on Meta Quest 3 on March 26, 2026.

#TheBoysTriggerWarning #Gaming #IGN
title: The Boys: Trigger Warning - Official Gameplay Video | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
High stakes, big money, no mercy. Here's your look at the Payday: Aces High announcement trailer for this upcoming VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players. Nothing hits like the moment the mask goes on. Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and dismantle a criminal titan’s empire one explosive score at a time. Payday: Aces High will be available on Meta Quest and Steam VR in 2026.

#PaydayAcesHigh #Gaming #IGN
title: Payday: Aces High - Official Announcement Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Tiny Takeover Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creative adventure sandbox game developed by Mojang. Players can now interact with new versions of baby mobs from baby chickens, pandas, wolves, and more. Keep them as pets with rightful names and admire the chaos from tiny creatures in the Tiny Takeover update, available now for Minecraft.
title: Minecraft - Official Tiny Takeover Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Titan Gameplay Trailer for Invincible VS, the upcoming action fighting game developed by Quarter Up. Players will rock any match with Titan, the family man willing to do what's necessary to protect his family through the ability to cover himself in dense rock. 

Get a look at his heavy defense and hard-hitting punches in Invincible VS, launching on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an Open Beta running from April 9 through April 11 on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Invincible VS - Official Titan Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the DOPROS announcement trailer for this upcoming narrative-driven Orwell-inspired interrogation game that puts you in a high-stakes conversation with the Interrogator, who is just waiting for you to make the wrong move. You can try to wiggle, or you can confess your wrongdoings — either way, your fate is not in your hands anymore…or is it? DOPROS will be available on Steam in 2026.
title: DOPROS - Official Announcement Trailer

description:
Introducing Arbiter 131, a real-time tactical sci-fi strategy sim with a narrative focus in which you play as the titular Arbiter, analyzing citizen data to prioritize targets and remotely commanding police units. The question is, will you follow orders? 

Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3979580

#Arbiter131 #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Cascadou, a strategy deckbuilding roguelike card game developed by Mattis Folkestad. Players will assemble powerful decks to execute the prime sequence of cards, enabling a chain reaction towards victory. Explore multiple game modes, bend the rules with powerful stickers, and make use of upgrades to keep the run alive. Cascadou is launching on April 14 for PC (Steam).

#Cascadou #Gaming #IGN
title: Cascadou - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a closer look at Fishing Inc. in this trailer for the upcoming cozy incremental fishing game. Catch fish, upgrade your gear, and enjoy nature. Fishing Inc. will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Fishing Inc - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Vredo, the renowned specialist in overseeding and slurry injection, arrives in Farming Simulator 25. Watch the latest Farming Simulator 25 trailer to see the Vredo Pack, which features 12 machines and introduces wild boar roaming the land. Evers Agro also makes a return. Farming Simulator 25 is available now on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. The Vredo pack is also available separately or as part of the Year 2 Season Pass, which features the Vredo Pack, a bonus tractor, and additional content to be released in 2026.
title: Farming Simulator 25 - Official Vredo Pack Launch Trailer

description: Check out the Heike Trailer for War Robots: Frontiers, the hit free-to-play mech-based action shooter developed by MY.GAMES. Players will become acquainted with the new Heiki mech, a new Defender robot packed with Thunder Shotguns, an Ecdysis Core Gear, and more to pierce enemy defenses and secure victory. The Heike mech for War Robots: Frontiers is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher).
title: War Robots: Frontiers - Official Heike Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Accolades Trailer for WWE 2K26, the latest addition to the hit wrestling franchise developed by Visual Concepts. Players will live out iconic wrestling moments or create their own with a packed roster of WWE superstars across all eras. Take a look at the latest trailer to garner the critical reception behind WWE 2K26, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: WWE 2K26 - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest trailer for The Outlast Trials and get a look at gameplay from Season 6: Project Judas of the action horror game. The new Season of The Outlast Trials features a new trial: Silence the Idol, the new Mk-Challenge: Solve the Murder, new Deluxe Catalog: Project Judas, a new Limited-time event: Scavenger, X-ray and Barricade Rigs Rework, Invasion Ranks reset, Invasion Leaderboards, Murkoff Store restocked, Twitch drop event, and additional fixes and balancing. The Outlast Trials' Season 6: Project Judas is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox One.

It's time to adjust your Murkoff branded Television sets for the feature presentation: Project Judas. This Season, you will get to feast your eyes on the Kress Twins attempt at political takeover! Otto and Arora have prepared quite the show for you all in their new Trial Environment the Television Studio. Enjoy new MK-Challenges, survive the Scavenger Limited-Time Event, test
title: The Outlast Trials - Official Season 6: Project Judas Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Wartales teaser trailer for a peek at what you can expect from the upcoming Fires in the Capital DLC for the medieval open-world RPG. Wartales: Fires in the Capital will be available in April 2026.

In Isandrin, victory is not only about who stands at the end, but what remains of the city when the fighting stops.

Isandrin, eternal capital of the Edoran Empire and proud heart of the Legion, has long stood as a symbol of order and dominion. Its banners fly over a city built on discipline, faith, and conquest. Yet even this bastion now trembles from within.
title: Wartales: Fires in the Capital - Official DLC Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Blue Mary Character Breakdown Trailer for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, the hit fighting game developed by SNK. Players will get the rundown on the moveset, techniques, and abilities of Blue Mary, an up-close and personal grappler that keeps the pressure on the opposition. Fight as Blue Mary in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves on March 26 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#FatalFuryCityOfTheWolves #Gaming #IGN
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Blue Mary Character Breakdown Trailer

description: Watch the Cinematic Trailer for Annulus, a turn-based tactical RPG developed by Nirvana. Players will assume the role of a mercenary sect to make use of a diverse set of weapons, a suite of skills, and more. Annulus is launching on April 8 for iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
